import numpy as np
G=np.full((30,30),6,dtype=int)
# walls
G[:,11]=9
G[:15,20]=9
G[7,17:24]=9; G[8:14,17]=9; G[8:14,23]=9; G[14,17:24]=9
G[10,23:30]=9; G[11:15,23]=9
G[25,6:20]=9; G[26:30,6]=9; G[26:30,19]=9
# seeds
for (r,c),v in { (0,0):1,(1,1):8,(0,12):3,(1,13):2,(2,14):7,(0,21):8,(8,18):2,(9,19):1,(27,8):2}.items(): G[r,c]=v
# comps non9
from collections import deque
seen=np.zeros((30,30),bool); comps=[]
for r in range(30):
 for c in range(30):
  if G[r,c]!=9 and not seen[r,c]:
   q=[(r,c)];seen[r,c]=1; cells=[]
   while q:
    x,y=q.pop();cells.append((x,y))
    for dx,dy in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
     a,b=x+dx,y+dy
     if 0<=a<30 and 0<=b<30 and G[a,b]!=9 and not seen[a,b]:seen[a,b]=1;q.append((a,b))
   comps.append(cells)
for i,cs in enumerate(sorted(comps,key=lambda cs:min(x[0]*30+x[1] for x in cs))):
 r0=min(x for x,y in cs);r1=max(x for x,y in cs);c0=min(y for x,y in cs);c1=max(y for x,y in cs)
 marks=[(r,c,G[r,c]) for r,c in cs if G[r,c]!=6]
 print(i, len(cs), (r0,r1,c0,c1),'bboxarea',(r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1),'markers',marks)
